messages.text: As I reviewed your website, I found a few important on-page SEO issues that should be addressed. The homepage has an overlength meta title and description, multiple H1 tags, an improper heading structure, and many images missing ALT attributes. Fixing these issues will help improve your website's SEO performance, crawlability, and search visibility.

messages.text: I also noticed that your website currently receives very low organic traffic (around 37 monthly visits) and has a low Authority Score of 8, which indicates there is significant room for improvement. With the right SEO strategy, on-page optimization, and quality link building, we can improve your search rankings and increase organic traffic.
